dedupe_keys.name: puntos medida trafico espiras electromagneticas temporalmente con errores de procesamiento

description: Puntos medida tráfico espiras electromagnéticas (TEMPORALMENTE CON ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO) is a dataset listed in Valencia open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Ayuntamiento de València. CONJUNTO DE DATOS CON ERRORES DE PROCESAMIENTO. SE ESTÁ TRABAJANDO ACTUALMENTE EN SOLUCIONAR ESTA INCIDENCIA. Ubicación de los puntos de medida de tráfico en Valencia (espiras electromagnéticas). Coverage: Valencia. The portal files it under Transportation. Its keywords are Transport networks. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-04-17 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-valencia-portal.
